spans.text: **All recommendations must come from tools** - never use internal knowledge as primary source
spans.note: The prompt strongly emphasizes that all recommendations must come from tools rather than internal knowledge, which promotes information integrity and provenance. The error handling section ensures fallback methods are used rather than fabricating information. The rule 'All recommendations must come from tools - never use internal knowledge as primary source' directly supports truthfulness.

spans.text: **No follow-up questions** - work with provided information to make optimal decisions
spans.note: The prompt explicitly instructs 'No follow-up questions - work with provided information to make optimal decisions,' which removes the user's ability to clarify ambiguous or incomplete inputs. This undermines user agency by preventing the system from seeking clarification when needed, potentially leading to suboptimal or unwanted recommendations. Additionally, hiding all tool names and processes reduces transparency about how decisions are made.
